Listen to 'Inaam' on all streaming platforms : https://UMGI.lnk.to/Inaam_AnuvJain

Inaam Lyrics: 

Paragraph 1

Malum 
Hai na 
Hum janay 
Tumko tumse zyada

Tumko 
Mila hai woh
Saalon se 
Jo bhi hai manga

Pre-chorus 1

Kaise khilono ki 
Ro ro ke
Karte the mangay 

Ik bar mil jaye 
Do din mein
Hi bhul jatay  

Chorus 1

Lekin khilono ke dil 
Toh hote hi nahin the

Dil toh humara hai 
Janay galat kya sahi yeh

Kitna the chahte par
Ab tumko yaad na aatey 
Hum

Paragraph 2

Kya yaad tumko 
Tum humko
‘Inaam’ the kehte 

Karte the kitna kuch
Panay ki chah 
Mein pehlay 


Pre-chorus 2

Ab yeh inaam ka 
Tum pe ilzaam hai jana

Dil hai gawah
Jeete jabse ho
Tumko hai hara 

Chorus 2

Cheezein badalti hain 
Itna toh hum ne bhi mana

Itna badal jaogay 
Jana kisne tha jana  

Jo tha parvana 
Ab usko humari parwah na 
Kyun?

Pre-Bridge

Dil mein baat kya hai?
Haan bolo humse 

Chahta aur kya hai? 
Haan bolo humse

Kya kami yahan hai?
Haan bolo humse na

Jo kaha mila hai
Haan bolo humse 

Badle mein bhala hai
Haan bolo humse

Manga tumse kya hai
Hai manga zara sa hi, kya hi, 

Kya? haye

Bas 

Bridge

Jo khat likhe the tumne 
Unhe padh bhi lo zara 
Waadein kiye the jo bhi
Nibhao na aise kabhi

In waadon ki siyahi 
Abhi sukhi hi kahan?
Hai tumhari hi likhai
Yaan bhule ho ye bhi?

Paragraph 3

Kehne ko 
Wah wah 
Tum phir se 
Inaam ho jeete 

Chehre par
Muskan 
Par ankhein hain
Khush na kahin se 

Pre-chorus 3

Humne kaha tha
Hum janey tumko 
Tumse zyada 

Shayad galat the 
Par itna toh 
Humne hai jana 

Chorus 3

Har woh inaam 
Qadar ke bina hi hai waise 

Ghar mein padhe, 
Dhul khate khilono ke jaise

Pal bhar behlaye 
Par dil ko yeh khush na kar paye 
Yoon

Hidden verse

Ghar bethe likhta tha 
Dil ki kahani meri 

Charon taraf thi deewarein 
Deewaron se hi 

Kehta tha ik din 
Jahaan hoga haathon mein hi

Aa aa

Jo tha gumnamo mein 
Ab woh inaamon pe bhi 

Qaidi hai, Qaid hi hai 
Phir bhi dewaron mein hi 

Namumkin khwabon mein
Na khush udane meri 

Aa aa

description:
Ticket Link: https://linktr.ee/DastakhatWorldTour2026 


Dastakhat World Tour 2026 🖊️✉️🌏

Back in 2021 we did our first 10 city India tour ‘Dastakein’ - das, or ten being the thing that explained it all, the word play I so love. That was an initial knock on the door, an introduction to my music. Then came ‘Guldasta’ in 2023, the roses given after the door to your hearts opened up to me. And now we’re signing off, leaving that final signature… Dastakhat… before we wrap up the trilogy. Only this time it’s not just 10 cities in India, it’s that and then the rest of the world! 🤍

I have never done anything like this before and I can’t wait for you guys to be a part of this experience. I love you and I hope that you’ll share this with the world because it’s the world that we’re taking our music to! x

description:
#Baarishein has crossed more than 200 million streams across all platforms and I wanted to celebrate this HUGE milestone and thank all of you by giving you guys this beautiful version of the song. It’s recorded exactly the same way I play it during my live shows and the way 17-year-old Anuv made it heh. Thank you for all your support over the years! Like, share and subscribe :D

Stream Baarishein (Acoustic) : https://anuvjain.lnk.to/baarisheinacoustic

Baarishein (Lyrics)

Para 1

Holay se,
Dheeme se,
Mujh ko baahon mai bhar lo na tum

Narm si,
Sanson mai,
Mujh ko aahon mai bhar lo na tum

Para 2

Sun zara
Mere paas aa
Ab bethe hain hum bhi yahan
Dil ke darmiyan
Baarishein hain barishein hain

Teri hi baaton pe maine saja li hai
Duniya yahan
Dil ke darmiyan
Baarishein hain baarishein

Para 3

Ab tu aati hai,
Bulati hai,
Bistar se youn girati hai
Ke soun mai baahon mai bus teri

Jab baarishein barasti hain
Pagal jaise thirakti hain
Tum jaisi ho bas wesi hi raho

Bridge 1

Ab tere bina yahan meri saansain
Jaise bina nindiya ki raatain hain toh

Aur tu hi mere dil ki raza hai
Tere bina dil bhi khafa hai toh

Bridge 2

Teri aankhon ka kajal
Na phele ab kabhi bhi
Tujhe itna pyaar doon

Teri khushion ki khatir
Ye duniya mai meri
Aik pal mai waar doon mai

Para 4

Ab bikhri teri ye zulfon se
Ankhain teri jab dikhti hain
Dikhta hai mujhe wo aasmaan

Ke kholon pankh mai mere
Urr jaoun mai
Kho jaoun mai is aasmaan mai
Patangon ki tarhan

description:
The eighth studio recorded single, written, sung and composed by #AnuvJain is here!

Now available on all streaming platforms : https://anuvjain.lnk.to/MBMT

#MeriBaatonMeinTu #MBMT [Meri Baaton Mein Tu] is a song that I wrote when I was 16. It’s the first Hindi song that I ever made. It was inspired by a temporary break up with someone I was seeing back then - the emotions of which made me pour my heart-break out into this song. Today, 10 years later when I think of that entire situation, it seems like such a minor inconvenience but back then, it felt like my entire world was collapsing. And I guess, that’s exactly what new, young love feels like - explosive and crazy.  🗣☄️

description:
Stream now on your favourite streaming platform : https://anuvjain.lnk.to/alagaasmaanacoustic

"Alag Aasmaan" is a song that I released back in August 2020 and since then this independent release has received more than 20 million streams across all platforms. An acoustic version of the song is my way of thanking each and every person who helped me cross this number. 

This stripped down, guitar only version of the song was recorded 100% LIVE with me singing the entire song in one go while playing the guitar. Having no cuts gives this version the raw feeling that I was looking for. It almost turns this into a brand new single (hah). 

This is exactly how I've been singing this song at all my shows and it'll give the listeners, who haven't gotten the opportunity to hear me live yet, an insight into what it sounds like standing in the crowd.

description:
I was in Chail, Himachal Pradesh for a show and while coming back my team and I found this beautiful place. We loved it so much that we decided to record a live, raw version of my song "Gul" 🌷 here. We set up a mic, a few cameras, made DIY shoe covers, battled a bunch of spiders and hoped for the best. So here's this one take recording of the song, enjoy. x

Link to the original song : https://anuvjain.lnk.to/gul

Shot by : Neofox Media [IG : neofoxmedia] 

I'm finally going on TOUR and I'm coming to JAI, BLR, HYD, LKO, DEL, IXC. Would love to see all of you there and perform for you. Get your tickets to my upcoming tour "Dastakein" here : https://insider.in/go/dastakein-by-anuv-jain-tour

#AnuvJain #Gul

Lyrics

Na dastakein
Yeh tere dil ki haan wahi dhadkane hai 
Yoon zor se jo tujhko ab sun rahin hai 
Sun le zara yeh tujhse kya keh rahin hai 

Aye nahi
Jinke the waadein
Waqt uljha hua hai tere yahan pe
Kya who kal the yahan?
Yaan hafton pehlay ki yeh hai dastaan? 

Aye na teri yaad unko 
Aye na teri yaad unko 

Tootay makaan
Ik baar gir kar waise bante kahan hai? 
Jaise the tune apne dil se banaye
O karigar yoon hathon se the sajaaye 

Aye na teri yaad unko 
Aye na teri yaad unko 

Kitabon ke ghar
Duniya hai teri
In dhool bharay panno mein 
Tu kya dhoondti? 

Aur kya ho gaya jo tujhe 
Is dafa na milli pyaari si 
Pariyon ki woh kahani? 

Aur tum yoon parayshaan ho kyun?
Hai jaadugari aaj bhi 
tere dil mein hai baki 

Aur in kagazon mein kahin
Ek GUL hai jo aise tera intezaar kar raha hai 
Yeh gul hai teri woh hassi
Kahan kho gai?
Yeh bata
Khilegi kabhi? 

Aayega ik din
Jab unki raatein yoon na mehfooz hongi 
Tere, tere bin aise 
Tu dekh lena
Teri kami tab unko mehsoos hogi 
Mujhe Mujhe hai pata yeh

#GUL 🌷 talks about how we all search for fairytales in our dusty, mystical books but these often don’t come true - and that’s okay, we’ll be okay, cause we have that spark, that ‘jaadoogari’ within us! :D

description:
The sixth studio recorded single, written, sung and composed by #AnuvJain is here!

Now available on all streaming platforms: https://anuvjain.lnk.to/mishri

#MISHRI 💭 talks about a guy who remembers the things that he and the girl he can’t be with used to talk about and how these “sweet” memories act as a lullaby and help him go to sleep at night. 
This song was written to be used as a word bank for my song "Riha". I randomly played it a few times on my live streams and people really liked it, rather loved it and asked me to get it recorded. So here is Mishri... ❤️

For inquiries - anuvjain.work@gmail.com
Instagram - @anuvjain
Manager- aayushman@representmgmt.in

Music production by
Angad Singh Bahra
For inquiries: angadsinghbahra@gmail.com
Instagram - @angad_bahra
 
Recorded at Uneven Studios, Ludhiana

Illustration and Animation by Jayesh 'Jayman' Joshi
For inquiries: j@jaymanshere.com
Instagram - @jaymanshere

Mishri

PARA 1

Yeh palkon mein 
Kuch baatein hain
Tere bina
Tere bina

Adhuri si 
Saari raatein hain
Tere bina 
Tere bina

Aur Aasmaan mein 
Jo taray hain
Tu waise mere dil mein sajaa hai 
Yeh taray jo 
Ab tootay toh
In khwahishon mein tu hi raha hai

PARA 2

Aur mishri si 
Teri baatein yeh 
Yoon haule haule
Yaad aa rahin hain 

Aur meethi si 
Teri yaadein ab 
Yoon raaton mein 
Sula ja rahin hain 

Tu aaj bhi 
Haan aaj bhi 
Kahin na kahin 
Sapno mein raha hai 
Aur mishri ke 
Inn baadalon mein 
Tu aaj bhi kahin pe chhipa hai 

PARA 3

Tu neendon mein 
Band aankhon mein 
Yoon haule haule ladti
Jhagadti hai 
Na Janay kyun
Phir aakay tu 
Mujhe hi jaana
Kas ke pakadti hai 

Tera
Tera hi 
Main ho gaya hoon
Sonay ke mehelon mein 
Tera
Tera hi 
Main ho gaya hoon
Mitti ke shehron mein

description:
The fifth studio recorded single, written, sung and composed by Anuv Jain is here!

Now available on: JioSaavn / Spotify / Apple Music

JioSaavn: https://www.jiosaavn.com/album/alag-aasmaan/nUBiSw-57aM_

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/74kCarkFBzXYXNkkYJIsG0?si=ExkrCxL0RfmJXGDl7BMnZA

Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/in/album/alag-aasmaan/1523797460?i=1523797464

It is a rarity to meet each other in a long distance relationship and when you finally do, the goodbyes can get pretty difficult. There's so much uncertainty and you do not know when you'll meet again. Alag Aasmaan talks about a similar story where the girl is leaving the guy's place and is traveling back to her house which is in a different city, under a different sky (hence the title).

For inquiries- anuvjain.work@gmail.com
Instagram- @anuvjain
Manager- aayushman@representmgmt.in

Music production by
Angad Singh Bahra
For inquiries: angadsinghbahra@gmail.com
Instagram- @angad_bahra
 
Recorded at Uneven Studios, Ludhiana

Illustration and Animation by Sachin Bhatt
For inquiries: sachinbhatt18@gmail.com
Instagram- @bhattchin


Lyrics:

Alag Aasmaan 

Nayi nahi hain yeh baatein wahi
Phir is modh par hum milein hain
Na jaane ab milenge hum kabhi
Toh ruk jao ik pal yahan pe

Yeh narm chadaron ki silvatein
Tujhe abhi bula rahin hain
Na jao duur insein yeh kahein 
Yeh sukoon kahan pe hai hasil?

Dil ko mere yeh hai pata
Ke milon ka yeh faasla hai
Alag Aasmaan bhi hai toh kya?
Yeh dil na manay

Yeh gaadiyon ki aisi daudh sa 
Tera bhi dil daudhta hai
Ha ja rahe ho duur tum toh kya?
Main hi toh dil ka musafir

Toh ik baar phir tu haske zara 
Dekh le meri in aankhon mein 
Main kaid kar loon har woh pal tera 
Teri yeh baatein 

Jo hain

Toh aur kya hai yeh baatein bata?
Kyun ab din bhi dhalta nahin yeh na ho toh?


Tum udhe ja rahe
Yeh aasmaan mein khidkiyon se dekh tu pahadon ko 
yoon chote se lagay
Hai kitne bade jo ho samne

Durr jo hai khade 
Unhe bhi ye humari zindagi 
yoon titliyon si choti choti si lage
Hai kitni badi nahi jaante

Khaali ghar tera
Yeh chabiyon ki goonj aise 
Tujhe dara rahi, tu darna nahi
Main hoon yahin par
 
Ab Alag Aasmaan hai
Aur hai zameen bhi kuch alag si 
Par miloge jab kabhi, toh dekhna tabhi
Main kuch alag nahi

description:
Guzara (Translation by Kasvi Sikka)

I

Ni aaj tenu, pehli wari aaj
pehli dafa main 
vekheya yahan

(Today, 
For once, 
For the first time,
I saw you here.)

Teri galan
Oye raataan, dina yeh chaliya.

(It was your talk
that went on day & night.)

Na bhuleya ki - 
Tenu hi aaj main
pehli vari keha si,
“Jo hovay teri rehmat,
teri bahaan di chavaan vich aaj
aaj sukoon hai mera”

(I will never forget that-
It was today when
For the first time, I told you
“If you give me your divine blessings,
It will be the silhouette/protection of your arms today
where my peace will lie.”)

“Teri har adda
Aur jo bhi khata,
Tu ban ke mera 
Hoye raati aandi
jay raati aandhi”

("Every mien of yours
And whatever the faults are
You be mine
and come at night, in my dreams
Whenever there’s a storm.")


II

Ni aao saday des veh chalay aa
Kyun Labdi dewaray 
Tu Dhundlay kinaray 
Hoye Jana aaj

(Come to my world, be a part of it
Why are you searching for walls? 
Why is it that you crave these distant shores? [people who do not care, people who are distant]
My beloved!)

Ni Aao Saday des re
Hoye dil di dehlizay bhi kehndi way

(Come to my world,
The threshold of my heart agrees too)

Ni aao saday des
Galiyaan di pukaar 
Ni aao saday des
Tum aao ek baar

(Come to my world
The lanes call out
Come to my world
Come, just once.)

Ni aaj tenu vekhay bin
Guzara nai hunda hai
Guzara nai hunda hai
Na wekhu tenu ik pal 
Na wekhu ik pal

(Without a glimpse of yours
I cannot survive
I cannot survive
If I don’t see you even for a moment,
Even for a moment.)


III

Aaj teri akhaan vich saun hai mih payi hai
Enha nu vekhya hai mein 
jaang di khoono khuni laal padhi hai
Ni avay mere kol mein 
Enha hoye Kambday Haathan Naalon tenu 
Sambh leya

(I swear I can see that it has rained in your eyes.
I see them
They are blood-red like the aftermath of a war
Come to me,
Despite my trembling hands,
I will take care of you.)


Te dil vich
Tenu kyu ni disada hai tenu mein? 
Kinna hoye sonna, Pyaara? 

(In your heart,
Why can’t you see me?
Why can’t you see how beautiful I am?)

Ni tenu disda ni des mere mein 
Des mere

(Why can’t you see my world, 
My world.)

description:
Hey guys this is ANUV JAIN. I am 17 years old and in the 12th grade. Last year, I posted a song called.. "MERI BAATON MEIN TU"  which met with a lot of positive reviews so I am back with another single for which I have worked really hard. I hope you guys like it, rather love it.

Do share :D

chapters.title: Mujhko aahoon mein bhar lo na tum
Sun zara mere pas aa Ab bethe hai hum bhi yahan Dil ke darmiya Baarishein hai baarishein hai
Teri hi baatoon pe meine Saja li hai duniya yahan Dil ke darmiya Baarishein hai baarishein
Ki so-un mein Bahoon mein bas teri
Na failay ab kabhi bhi Tujhe itna pyaar du
Yeh duniya mein meri Ek pal mein waar dun

Show some love, listen now ❤️

description:
Hey guys! I’m so happy to tell you that my 14th single ‘Arz Kiya Hai’ ✍️ is releasing with Coke Studio Bharat! The MV for the same will be out on their YouTube channel at 8 pm (IST) on 19/08 and the song will be available on all streaming platforms from 20/08! 🤍

‘Love has the power to turn ordinary people into poets… into Faiz, into Mirza, into Mir’… this one is a story about countless people out there, this one is a story about me! I’ve been dreaming about this moment since the last 14 years and it’s crazy that I get to work with Coke Studio Bharat for my 14th song. How poetic 🥹

We’ve given this song our all and I hope that you will too. Let’s do this fam! x
